'''Doreen''' was a [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld]] located in the [[Doreen system/Legends|Doreen system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Situated near [[the Tangles]] area of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was linked via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Kalgo system/Legends|Kalgo]] and [[Usnia system/Legends|Usnia systems]]. The surface of Doreen featured gentle [[Water/Legends|waters]] and scattered islands.<ref name="TEA" />

Doreen was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a type of titanic [[Doreenian cetacean|cetacean]] that vomited up [[Doreenian ambergris]], a substance that was valued by many offworld [[Perfume/Legends|perfumers]]. The ambergris was commonly found floating on the water or washed ashore on the perimeter of Doreen's islands. Consequently, gangs of [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] equipped with [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmers]] plagued the planet, and the security forces of [[House Petro]], one of the Senex-Juvex's [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]], hunted them.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doreen was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
